title: Prescriptions Desk System Card: Declining a Controlled Owed Balance
content:
A patient may decline the open owed balance of a Kestrel Prescriptions record in the Schedule V Controlled Prescription, Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription or Schedule II Controlled Prescription class — the units still owed after a controlled short fill — and receive the controlled decline credit for them.

## Governing rule

- The balance itself is cancelled for its full owed units exactly as the Prescriptions owed-balance rules provide, a cancelled Schedule II balance staying void; the cancelled units are never dispensed afterwards, and the credit is recorded on the cancellation entry.
- The patient pay of a controlled short fill covers the full prescribed quantity, so the part of it that paid for units that will now never be dispensed is credited. The controlled decline credit is returned by the original payment method.
- Except for this credit, a controlled fill that was dispensed correctly is never taken back or refunded, whatever the reason the patient gives.

## Capability of the tool

`decline_controlled_owed_balance_a6435942` lets the patient decline, in person, the units Kestrel still owes on a controlled-substance prescription dispensed short, and take back the credit for them. One call cancels the named controlled owed balance for its full owed units: it books a balance cancellation entry on the prescription's fill ledger that names the owed-balance entry, records today's date, the units cancelled and the credit returned to the patient, and lowers the prescription's owed quantity by those units. The cancelled units are never dispensed afterwards. After the call the patient sees the balance as cancelled and the credit amount on the entry, and the owed-balance entry is no longer open.

## How it is invoked

This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the patient — then runs it (through `call_user_discoverable_tool`).

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `source_fill_id` | the reference number of the controlled owed-balance entry being declined, as the agent reads it from the prescription's fill ledger and tells the patient | text identifier |
| `refund_usd` | the credit returned to the patient for the declined units, as the agent states it | USD with 2 decimal places, a positive amount rounded to the cent |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary: `cancellation_id` (text, the new fill-ledger reference), `source_fill_id` (text, the owed-balance entry cancelled), `owed_units_cancelled` (integer dosage units no longer owed), `refund_usd` (number, USD with 2 decimal places credited), `owed_quantity_after` (integer units still owed on the prescription) and `status` (text, "controlled_balance_declined" when the entry was written).
